import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def repeatedRows(matrix):
    row_dict = defaultdict(list)
    for i, row in enumerate(matrix):
        row_dict[tuple(row)].append(i)
    return [indices[1:] for indices in row_dict.values() if len(indices) > 1]

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    R = int(input[0])
    C = int(input[1])
    matrix = [[int(input[R * C + i * C + j]) for j in range(C)] for i in range(R)]
    result = repeatedRows(matrix)
    flat_result = [str(index) for indices in result for index in indices]
    print(" ".join(flat_result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
